release_notes: Buyer Log 7.0.192 TEST: PLM sample requests (CoreNectum Requests tab: Artwork, Fit Sample, Perfect Sign Off, PPS) are tracked in CP. New CP › PLM SYNC › Update PLM Sample Status fetches requests for selected (or filtered) CP rows. Checklist PPS / S/Off / critical sample / new Artwork questions close automatically when PLM has an approved request; open or rejected requests are shown with their PLM status; questions without a PLM request are still asked. Right-click a style in CP/Orders › PLM sample requests shows the PLM request table. Collection PLM Sync does not fetch sample requests.
